summary: The CareGist dashboard at https://www.caregist.co.uk/dashboard provides the self-serve equivalent of a caller workflow. Customers sign in, receive a feed of provider intelligence (56,742 new-registration events from a trusted event ledger), filter by 7 dimensions (provider, region, authority, service type, provider type, postcode, date range), record outcomes (saved views, weekly digest), export results (CSV/Excel), and the Business tier adds programmatic delivery via webhooks. The workflow is self-serve rather than VA-operated, but the functional equivalent exists: sign in ✓, receive work (feed) ✓, record outcomes (filters/saved views) ✓, resume (persisted state) ✓.
assertions: Dashboard provides authenticated feed of 56,742 new-registration events from trusted event ledger
7 filter dimensions: provider, region, authority, service type, provider type, postcode, date range
CSV and Excel export buttons available in dashboard
Saved views and weekly digest for outcome recording and resumption
Business tier adds programmatic delivery via webhooks
Confidence scoring per provider (e.g., Bravo Medical 0.99)
